# Random Canvas Game Idea

**Title:** Meteor Escape

**Concept:** The player controls a spaceship constantly moving forward in a starfield. Meteors spawn from the top and travel toward the ship. The player can move left/right and boost up/down to dodge. Collect power‑ups for temporary shields or speed.

**Lose Condition:** The ship is destroyed on collision with a meteor while no shield is active, triggering a Game Over screen.

**Goal:** Survive as long as possible and earn a high score based on time and collected power‑ups.

1: // Game based on IDEA.md – Meteor Escape
2: // Targets canvas element with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const { width, height } = canvas;
9:   // ----- Audio -----
10:   const sounds = {
11:     explosion: new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/jasonm23/awesome-sounds/explosion.mp3'),
12:     shield: new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/jasonm23/awesome-sounds/powerup.mp3'),
13:     bg: new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/jasonm23/awesome-sounds/bg.mp3')
14:   };
15:   sounds.bg.loop = true;
16:   sounds.bg.volume = 0.3;
17:   sounds.bg.play();
18: 
19:   // ----- Input -----
20:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false, ArrowUp: false, ArrowDown: false };
21:   addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = true; });
22:   addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = false; });
23: 
24:   // ----- Enhanced Graphics -----
25:   // Starfield background
26:   const stars = [];
27:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
28:   for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
29:     stars.push({
30:       x: Math.random() * width,
31:       y: Math.random() * height,
32:       size: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
33:       speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2
34:     });
35:   }
36: 
37:   function updateStars(dt) {
38:     for (const s of stars) {
39:       s.y += s.speed * dt * 0.05; // adjust speed based on dt
40:       if (s.y > height) {
41:         s.x = Math.random() * width;
42:         s.y = -s.size;
43:         s.size = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
44:         s.speed = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2;
45:       }
46:     }
47:   }
48: 
49:   function drawStars() {
50:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
51:     for (const s of stars) {
52:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size);
53:     }
54:   }
55: 
56:   // Ship drawing with gradient
57:   const ship = {
58:     x: width / 2,
59:     y: height - 60,
60:     w: 30,
61:     h: 40,
62:     speed: 4,
63:     shield: false,
64:     draw() {
65:       ctx.save();
66:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
67:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -this.h / 2, 0, this.h / 2);
68:       grad.addColorStop(0, this.shield ? 'cyan' : 'lightgray');
69:       grad.addColorStop(1, this.shield ? 'blue' : 'white');
70:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
71:       ctx.beginPath();
72:       ctx.moveTo(0, -this.h / 2);
73:       ctx.lineTo(-this.w / 2, this.h / 2);
74:       ctx.lineTo(this.w / 2, this.h / 2);
75:       ctx.closePath();
76:       ctx.fill();
77:       ctx.restore();
78:     },
79:     update() {
80:       if (keys.ArrowLeft) this.x -= this.speed;
81:       if (keys.ArrowRight) this.x += this.speed;
82:       if (keys.ArrowUp) this.y -= this.speed * 1.5;
83:       if (keys.ArrowDown) this.y += this.speed * 0.5;
84:       this.x = Math.max(this.w / 2, Math.min(width - this.w / 2, this.x));
85:       this.y = Math.max(this.h / 2, Math.min(height - this.h / 2, this.y));
86:     }
87:   };
88: 
89:   class Meteor {
90:     constructor() {
91:       this.r = Math.random() * 15 + 10;
92:       this.x = Math.random() * (width - this.r * 2) + this.r;
93:       this.y = -this.r;
94:       this.speed = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
95:       // create a radial gradient for each meteor
96:       this.grad = null;
97:     }
98:     update() { this.y += this.speed; }
99:     draw() {
100:       const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(this.x, this.y, this.r * 0.2, this.x, this.y, this.r);
101:       gradient.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
102:       gradient.addColorStop(1, '#444');
103:       ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
104:       ctx.beginPath();
105:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
106:       ctx.fill();
107:     }
108:     offScreen() { return this.y - this.r > height; }
109:     collides(ship) {
110:       const dx = this.x - ship.x;
111:       const dy = this.y - ship.y;
112:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
113:       return dist < this.r + Math.max(ship.w, ship.h) / 2;
114:     }
115:   }
116: 
117:   class PowerUp {
118:     constructor() {
119:       this.r = 12;
120:       this.x = Math.random() * (width - this.r * 2) + this.r;
121:       this.y = -this.r;
122:       this.speed = 1.5;
123:       this.pulse = 0;
124:     }
125:     update(dt) { this.y += this.speed; this.pulse += dt * 0.005; }
126:     draw() {
127:       const pulseScale = 0.8 + Math.abs(Math.sin(this.pulse)) * 0.2;
128:       ctx.save();
129:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
130:       ctx.scale(pulseScale, pulseScale);
131:       ctx.fillStyle = 'gold';
132:       ctx.beginPath();
133:       ctx.arc(0, 0, this.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
134:       ctx.fill();
135:       ctx.restore();
136:     }
137:     offScreen() { return this.y - this.r > height; }
138:     collides(ship) {
139:       const dx = this.x - ship.x;
140:       const dy = this.y - ship.y;
141:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
142:       return dist < this.r + Math.max(ship.w, ship.h) / 2;
143:     }
144:   }
145: 
146:   
147:   const meteors = [];
148:   const powerUps = [];
149:   let lastMeteor = 0;
150:   let lastPower = 0;
151:   let score = 0;
152:   let startTime = performance.now();
153:   let gameOver = false;
154: 
155:   function spawnMeteor() {
156:     meteors.push(new Meteor());
157:   }
158:   function spawnPower() {
159:     powerUps.push(new PowerUp());
160:   }
161: 
162:   function update(dt) {
163:     if (gameOver) return;
164:     ship.update();
165: 
166:     // spawn meteors every 800ms
167:     if (performance.now() - lastMeteor > 800) { spawnMeteor(); lastMeteor = performance.now(); }
168:     // spawn power-ups every 5000ms
169:     if (performance.now() - lastPower > 5000) { spawnPower(); lastPower = performance.now(); }
170: 
171:     meteors.forEach(m => m.update());
172:     powerUps.forEach(p => p.update());
173: 
174:     // remove off‑screen meteors
175:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
176:       if (meteors[i].offScreen()) meteors.splice(i, 1);
177:     }
178:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
179:       if (powerUps[i].offScreen()) powerUps.splice(i, 1);
180:     }
181: 
182:     // collisions
183:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
184:       if (meteors[i].collides(ship)) {
185:         if (ship.shield) {
186:           // shield absorbs meteor
187:           sounds.explosion.play();
188:           ship.shield = false; // shield consumed
189:           meteors.splice(i, 1);
190:         } else {
191:           // ship destroyed
192:           sounds.explosion.play();
193:           gameOver = true;
194:         }
195:         break;
196:       }
197:     }
198:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
199:       if (powerUps[i].collides(ship)) {
200:         ship.shield = true; // activate shield
201:         powerUps.splice(i, 1);
202:       }
203:     }
204: 
205:     // scoring based on survival time
206:     const now = performance.now();
207:     score = Math.floor((now - startTime) / 1000);
208:   }
209: 
210:   function draw() {
211:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
212:     // starfield background (simple)
213:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
214:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
215:     // draw ship, meteors, power‑ups
216:     ship.draw();
217:     meteors.forEach(m => m.draw());
218:     powerUps.forEach(p => p.draw());
219:     // UI
220:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
221:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
222:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
223:     if (ship.shield) {
224:       ctx.fillStyle = 'cyan';
225:       ctx.fillText('Shield', 10, 40);
226:     }
227:     if (gameOver) {
228:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
229:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
230:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
231:       ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', width / 2, height / 2);
232:     }
233:   }
234: 
235:   function loop(timestamp) {
236:     const dt = timestamp - (lastRender || timestamp);
237:     lastRender = timestamp;
238:     update(dt);
239:     draw();
240:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
241:   }
242:   let lastRender;
243:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
244: })();

(End of file - total 244 lines)
</content>
